summary_evidence_spans: This study examined changes in students' self-reported creativity-related behaviors following an educational intervention combining artificial intelligence (AI) tools and the DRAE instructional model (Diagnosis, Recreation, Application, and Estimation).
A one-group preexperimental pretest-posttest questionnaire design was complemented by semi-structured interviews and direct-observation records.
However, retrospective record linkage, limitations in cross-instrument correspondence, self-report measurement, and the absence of a comparison group restrict causal interpretation.
The findings do not establish an independent causal effect of AI or validate the DRAE model.

original_excerpt: This study used cross-sectional PISA data from adolescents in four Chinese regions. … Unweighted multiple linear regression analyses examined economic, social and cultural status (ESCS) and AI use for schoolwork in relation to school loneliness and school belonging. … Higher ESCS and more frequent AI use for schoolwork were associated with lower school loneliness and greater school belonging.

summary_evidence_spans: This study used cross-sectional PISA data from adolescents in four Chinese regions.
Unweighted multiple linear regression analyses examined economic, social and cultural status (ESCS) and AI use for schoolwork in relation to school loneliness and school belonging.
Higher ESCS and more frequent AI use for schoolwork were associated with lower school loneliness and greater school belonging.

claim_text: 來源機構：BMC Psychology（Springer Nature）；資料標題：This study examines the factors associated with Chinese secondary school teachers’ intentions to teach artificial intelligence using structural equation modeling and machine learning；來源刊登日：2026-11-19。作者摘要報告：研究擴展計畫行為理論，納入 AI 素養、促進條件與 AI 焦慮，建構探討教師教授 AI 意願的動機架構；以 218 名中學資訊科技教師的橫斷面調查資料進行共變數結構方程模型分析，並另以機器學習分類分析檢視相關變項的預測表現。（AI 輔助摘要，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）
source_title: This study examines the factors associated with Chinese secondary school teachers’ intentions to teach artificial intelligence using structural equation modeling and machine learning
title_zh: 以結構方程模型與機器學習探討中國中學教師教授人工智慧意願的相關因素
source_locator: 出版社文章頁（link.springer.com，2026-11-20 讀取 200）：Published: 19 November 2026；摘要歸屬：Abstract 第 3、4、5 句
original_excerpt: In response to this research gap, the present study expands the Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB) by integrating AI literacy, facilitating conditions and AI anxiety, thereby developing a more integrative motivational framework for investigating teachers’ intentions to teach AI. … Using cross-sectional survey data from 218 secondary school information technology teachers, covariance-based structural equation modeling was employed to test the hypothesized relationships. … Machine learning classification analyses were additionally conducted to examine the predictive performance of the theoretically relevant variables.
interpretation_note: 轉述作者摘要的研究架構、樣本、資料與分析方法；解釋變異量、各路徑關聯、預測表現的數值與作者建議不寫入。

summary_evidence_spans: In response to this research gap, the present study expands the Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB) by integrating AI literacy, facilitating conditions and AI anxiety, thereby developing a more integrative motivational framework for investigating teachers’ intentions to teach AI.
Using cross-sectional survey data from 218 secondary school information technology teachers, covariance-based structural equation modeling was employed to test the hypothesized relationships.
Machine learning classification analyses were additionally conducted to examine the predictive performance of the theoretically relevant variables.
